canonical_incident_record.title: ACB hospital station unable to induct totes; site later restored
canonical_incident_record.incident_description: Case 223554 concerns a UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH) hospital-station incident described as 'acb hospital unable to induct.' Source evidence shows the hospital station could not add/induct totes, with related reports that the robot was in a shut down state. Supporting notes and work-order evidence mention AGV hospital station server issues and a need to reset services. Later same-day chat evidence shows a second or continuing operational disruption in which the site was reported down or unable to start sort, with discussion of AGVs in incorrect locations or with disconnected/associated totes. Final same-day updates state the system was running and the issue was resolved by about 9:00 PM ET.
canonical_incident_record.customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The customer could not induct totes at the hospital station, experienced hospital backlog, and later reported inability to start sort or a site-down condition until recovery actions restored operation.
canonical_incident_record.what_resolved_it: Source evidence gives multiple same-day recovery statements. Case closure summary says Opti sweep services were reset and the site restarted Hospital Lane. Later chat summary says disconnected/inducted totes were removed via API-based actions, several AGVs were taken out to restore flow, and the system was back running by 9:00 PM ET. Preserve both as source-reported resolution evidence rather than a single normalized procedure.
